title: On Utility-optimal Entanglement Routing in Quantum Networks
summary: Quantum networks are envisioned to enable reliable distribution and manipulation of quantum information across distances, forming the foundation of a future quantum internet. The fair and efficient allocation of communication resources in such networks has been addressed through the quantum network utility maximization (QNUM) framework, which optimizes network utility under the assumption of predetermined routes for competing user demands.
